text.card: A red giant 2,181 parsecs away, 8 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.88 solar masses and 8.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,533 K at its surface.
